questions.question: The apostle Peter wrote that anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin. True or false?
The apostle Peter wrote that the end of all things is near. Believers should be clear-minded and sober so they can do what?
In his letter to believers, what did the apostle Peter say to do above all?
The apostle Peter told believers to speak God's words and serve with the strength God provides. Why did he want them to do this?

answers.text: So God may be glorified in all things
So the church will be admired by all
So their leaders will be pleased with them
